links.comparator_used: Fully automatic AI (RapidAI) CTP maps without neuroradiologist review or correction
links.outcome: Proportion of CTP maps rated reportable
links.effect: 65.2% reportable without artifacts from AI software alone vs 87.9% reportable after neuroradiologist review (n=132)
links.quote: The study found that CTP maps derived from AI software were reportable in 65.2% of cases without artifacts and improved to 87.9% reportable cases when reviewed by neuroradiologists.

design_hint: clinician review and correction of AI outputs
